snippet.title: NickEh30's Family-Friendly GTA 6 Era Lasted 6 Days
snippet.description:
ickEh30 built his entire online personality around being family-friendly.

Then he started playing GTA 6.

What followed was six days, roughly 65 hours of gameplay, one very questionable attempt at keeping things family-friendly, and a transformation nobody expected.

From asking for a family-friendly mode to a chaotic zoo rampage, from the first day to becoming officially IRREDEEMABLE, this is the story of NickEh30's GTA 6 week told day by day.

But was it really a family-friendly GTA experiment, or did the joke completely take over?

Watch what happened, and decide for yourself.

Thank you for watching!
